items.title: Lockheed Martin (LMT) Opens Strigo Center To Speed Modular Missile Development
items.summary: Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) has launched its Strigo Product Center to speed up development of modular missile technology solutions. The company is backing the new center with a US$250 million investment focused on radio frequency sensors and missile seekers. Strigo is designed to move concepts to tested capabilities in months instead of years, aiming to accelerate deployment of advanced defense systems.
